scenario: N1 control — a definitively-cool reading (10 > 85 false) does NOT block, so AllCool fires. Facts: Sensor + Tick + AllCool = 3. Contrast LNUL.4.7a: null behaves like a hot reading (blocks), not a cool one.
rules_ds:
schema Tick scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float? mutable

schema AllCool scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule all_cool:
    Tick t
    no Sensor s where s.state > 85.0
->
    emit AllCool logical id: t.id
